visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a navy blue baseball cap and a gray t-shirt stands alongside a young girl in a pink hoodie. They are indoors in a well-lit living room with curtains and a wall-mounted air conditioner in the background. The man holds a large, rectangular pink box labeled 'TOP TOY' and 'HELLO KITTY AND FRIENDS'. They both smile broadly at the camera, gesturing toward the product. (2) The girl begins opening the large box, pulling out smaller individual blind boxes. The man assists, his hands moving quickly to help reveal the contents. They hold the boxes close to the camera, showcasing the colorful packaging. The setting remains static, but their physical movements are energetic as they prepare to unbox. (3) The girl tears open a silver foil bag and reveals a pink plush My Melody character wearing a lacy white collar. She holds it up for a close-up, turning it around to show the back which has a heart-shaped clip. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the soft texture of the plush toy. (4) The unboxing continues as they reveal a brown plush character. The man and girl show high-arousal facial expressions, with mouths open and wide eyes. A visual edit adds a zoom-in effect on their faces followed by graphic speed lines to emphasize their shock and joy. (5) A third person, a woman with blonde-tinted hair, enters the frame from the right. She helps open the final box, revealing a white Cinnamoroll plush. The three of them crowd together, holding up multiple plushies toward the camera lens. (6) In the final phase, the camera captures all three individuals holding the entire collection of opened plushies—My Melody, Kuromi, Hello Kitty, and others. They wave the toys at the camera, their faces filled with excitement before the video ends.
